{{Top|leg}}
The '''Reaction system''' [[Cybernetics/Legends|implant]] artificially augmented the user's [[nervous system]] by allowing impulses to travel faster and farther along the nerve bundle pathways. This resulted in an enhanced reaction time and increased accuracy from the improvement of fine motor control.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
